methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator creates institutional infrastructure for peer-to-peer learning and regional capability building, potentially seeding deep distributed expertise if partnerships extend beyond university walls into broader Hampton Roads workforce.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership signals intentional community-wide literacy investment beyond elite technical training, distributing foundational capability across Richmond's workforce rather than concentrating in traditional tech corridors.

signals.title: Cabinet secretary: Southside county loses two economic development prospects due to uncertainty over data center taxes
signals.signal_reading: Data center tax uncertainty blocking Greensville County economic development reveals how infrastructure-layer policy failures prevent even shallow AI deployment from reaching historically underserved regions, reinforcing existing concentration patterns.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia demonstrates grassroots capacity-building outside traditional tech hubs, though success depends on whether training produces deep capability or merely compliance-level adoption.

signals.title: When AI imagines cities, smaller communities can disappear - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech research showing AI systematically erases smaller communities from generated urban imagery serves as metaphor for actual policy risk—algorithmic systems trained on concentrated data could further marginalize rural Virginia in planning and investment decisions.
